name: RatterAU's Apps
subtitle: Free, no ads, no accounts, no tracking.
description: Apps I built because I wanted a better version of something. All free and open source, with no ads, no accounts and no analytics. Every app here is built from its public GitHub repository and installed straight from that repository's releases.

apps.name: Contrail
apps.subtitle: See a plane, tap it, know where it's going.
apps.localizedDescription:
A flight tracker with no ads, no paywalls and no nonsense. Tap any plane to see where it came from, where it's going and exactly what it is: airline, aircraft type, registration, a credited photo of that very aircraft, altitude, speed and whether it's on autopilot.

• Routes it can prove: checks the plane's real path before showing a route, and says when a listing is wrong
• The whole flown path back to the runway, with an altitude and speed profile you can scrub
• Two weeks of past flights for any plane, with replays at up to 1000×
• Pilot weather: satellite clouds, turbulence, icing and storm warnings, winds aloft
• Any airport live: weather, the runway in use, arrivals and departures
• Planes near me, with which way to look

No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Your phone talks straight to free public feeds.

versions.localizedDescription:
Following a plane works properly and costs far less battery. The traffic around a followed plane keeps refreshing (on Android it stopped; on iPhone it refreshed every second). On Android, following at country zoom went from 65% of a CPU core to 11%.

Accessibility, both apps. TalkBack and VoiceOver read each figure with its name ("Altitude, 35,000 ft"), and buttons and headings are announced as such. Text fits at large font sizes. With Reduce motion on, the map jumps instead of flying, the rain radar holds its latest frame, and the wind streaks stay still.

Fixes
• Android: the Automatic clock now follows the phone's 12/24-hour setting.
• Android: card text in dark mode is white again, not grey.
• Android: a failed OpenSky lookup is retried instead of hiding the plane's earlier path for the session.
• iPhone: route codes and airport temperature grow with the text size.

Updating: install app-release.apk over the top on Android, or Install from URL again in LiveContainer. Settings are kept.
Routes show seconds sooner on both apps: route legs now come straight from adsb.lol's VRS standing-data files (under half a second, was 6-9 s), and the route no longer waits for the aircraft photo.
Audit pass over feeds, routes, weather and battery on both apps.

Past flights, replayed — and now on iPhone too.
• Past flights redesigned: grouped by day, with a summary of the plane's last two weeks. Tap a flight to replay it on the map at up to 1000×, and drag through it to any moment.
• Fewer "Unknown" airports. When an end wasn't seen but the path fits the published route, it's filled in and labelled Scheduled.
• Routes no longer go missing when a lookup times out, and stale listings are corrected from the routes each flight was actually seen flying.
• Shorter aircraft names ("Embraer ERJ 190" instead of the full registry name).

Android: download app-release.apk below on your phone and open it. Already have an older version? It installs straight over the top.

iPhone (iOS 26): in LiveContainer, tap + → Install from URL and paste
https://github.com/RatterAU/Contrail/releases/latest/download/Contrail.ipa
Don't AirDrop the .ipa. Full steps in the README.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Contrail centres the map on you and shows which planes are overhead.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Sky view and Near you use the compass to show which way to look.

apps.name: Adelaide Transit
apps.subtitle: Do I need to leave now?
apps.localizedDescription:
Live tracking for every Adelaide Metro bus, tram and train: where it actually is, not where it's scheduled.

• Every tracked vehicle on the map, sliding between GPS updates
• Countdowns and clock times, colour-coded for early, on time and late
• Tells you plainly when you're too far away to make it on foot
• Only shows services you can actually board at that stop
• Favourites, alerts and full trip views

No accounts, no ads, no backend. Everything happens on your phone, straight from Adelaide Metro's public data.

versions.localizedDescription:
Install with LiveContainer: + → Install from URL with the link in the README. See Install it.

AdelaideTransit.ipa is unsigned (LiveContainer signs it). It does not include the bus-details card; build from source for that. iOS 26 or newer. There is no Android version.

What's new
• Only buses you can catch. Services that end at a stop, or only drop people off there, are no longer listed as departures. At a terminus that was half the board. Applies after the app's automatic timetable re-download.
• No countdowns for buses that have gone. A bus that passed your stop, even ahead of schedule, reads "Departed".
• "Due" instead of vanishing. A bus just past its predicted minute but still on its way stays in the list.
• Old live times say so. "Live times last updated N ago" when predictions stop arriving.
• Favourites work offline after hours away, instead of reading "No departures".
• Alerts keep refreshing during a session, show "Until" dates and drop off when they end.
• Less data. The app follows the feed's new one-minute prediction cadence and checks a 256-byte header before downloading.
• VoiceOver labels for map markers, stop pins, departure rows and favourites.
• Settings shows when the timetable was downloaded; an empty stop says "No departures in the next …".

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Adelaide Transit shows nearby stops and centres the map on your location.

apps.name: Alembic
apps.subtitle: yt-dlp, on your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription:
The real yt-dlp running on your phone, with FFmpeg built in and a native interface. Pick a preset or any exact video and audio stream (AV1 with Opus, H.264 with AAC, anything yt-dlp finds), choose the container, trim a section, embed cover art and metadata, and save to the Files app.

yt-dlp updates itself from its official GitHub releases, and every update is checked against yt-dlp's release signature before it's used. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

versions.localizedDescription:
yt-dlp and FFmpeg as an iPhone app. Paste a link, pick exactly what you want, and it's saved on your phone.
• Any site yt-dlp supports, with quality, codec, container and exact-stream choices
• Audio only: M4A, MP3, Opus, FLAC or WAV
• Clips by time or chapter, playlists and channels, up to five downloads at once
• Cover art, metadata, chapters and subtitles written into the file
• SponsorBlock cuts out sponsors with no re-encoding and the audio still in sync
• A library with Apple's player, Save to Photos, and lossless MKV/WebM to MP4
• yt-dlp updates itself, only from signature-checked official releases

Install: in LiveContainer, add the source at https://ratterau.github.io/apps/ or use Install from URL with this release's Alembic.ipa. Needs iOS 26 or newer.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Alembic saves videos you choose to your photo library.
